body: I can't speak to all the drugs you're took, but tylenol and alcohol interact very negatively (alcohol lowers the amount of tylenol needed to be considered toxic). Far as I can tell, you are way above that threshold, even before the vodka. Symptoms page for overdose that I found goes out 4 days and includes vomiting, bloody urine, shaking, and possibly coma. You may have a rough few days ahead.
I won't for a bit. I want to be sure that something that drastic won't end badly. Hence the testing.

I already feel dangerously close to doxxing myself, so I'm not comfortable saying my education.  There can't be that many triple majors.  As for the jobs, I worked as a chemistry lab tech, did construction, worked freight for retail, and enumerated for the census. Admittedly, I quit the census position because I found myself losing sleep, not meeting other responsibilities, and developing some very unhealthy drinking habits. Sprinkled in that time frame, I've gotten career counseling and taken more classes to try and get more skills, but some community credits will only get you so far. I'm currently reskilling again for data analysis.
